description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the {@link org.tensorflow.Scope} class and additional 'handwritten' sample operator classes used in testing or demonstrating scope-related operations in the TensorFlow Java API. It primarily verifies naming conventions, scope hierarchies, and creation of operations within a given scope.

classes.name: Const
classes.description: A handwritten class representing a constant tensor operation, with static methods for creation with various input types.

classes.name: Mean
classes.description: A handwritten class modeling the computation of a mean over tensor data.

classes.name: SquaredDifference
classes.description: A handwritten class representing the squared difference operation between tensors.

classes.name: Variance
